messages:
Alex Kim: Planning an APAC-friendly office hours next Wed. Need to finalize recording consent and how we generate short clips for ads. Quick sync?

Priya Shah: Legal note: public reuse (ads/social) requires explicit speaker release. Internal sales clips are okay under standard webinar terms. We should show a clear line on the registration page for EU attendees.

Marco Ruiz: Ops plan: enable Zoom cloud recording + audio transcript, auto-export MP4 + VTT to our S3 bucket. I'll prepare a meeting template with host-only recording and disable local recording. Any objections?

Jenna Lee: No objections. Ops asks: (1) export VTT/SRT, (2) auto-render 30s and 60s clips plus thumbnails so marketing isn't manually trimming every asset. I can own the clip generation job if infra provides the bucket and role.

Omar Patel: I'll provision the S3 path and IAM role. Recommend file layout like: /webinars/2026-11-03-intl-officehours/full_recording.mp4, full_transcript.vtt, clips/30s/..., clips/60s/..., thumbnails/. Include UTC timestamp and speaker handle in filenames and a metadata CSV for clip start/end and UTMs.

Lina Torres: On routing: if replay_watch_pct >= 50% and domain not internal, mark MQL. We'll add UTM params per clip variant (organic vs paid) for attribution and different nurture flows.

Alex Kim: Priya — can Legal add a one-click speaker release checkbox in the invite? Short copy: "I grant Redwood permission to use brief clips of this session for marketing purposes (including paid ads)."

Priya Shah: Yes, add checkbox + link to full release. For EU registration copy I'll provide a GDPR-friendly line: "This session will be recorded and may be used for marketing clips. By registering you consent to this use."

Marco Ruiz: I'll share the Zoom template link in #eng-infra and attach it to the meeting ID. Template will enable cloud recording and transcript.

Jenna Lee: Clip pipeline plan: Zoom -> S3 raw -> Lambda trigger -> FFMPEG renders clips (30s/60s) + thumbnails + burn captions optional -> write metadata CSV for marketing. I'll add an ops runbook with manual trim fallback.

Omar Patel: S3 path provisioned and IAM role created. DM'ed Jenna the role.

Lina Torres: UTM schema suggestion: utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=clip&utm_campaign=officehours_20261103&utm_content={clip_variant}. I'll wire the watch-threshold rule in HubSpot.

Alex Kim: Checklist: speaker checkbox (Priya); Zoom template (Marco); S3 + IAM (Omar); lambda clipper + runbook (Jenna); UTM mapping + HubSpot rule (Lina); EU privacy copy (Priya). Anyone object?

Jenna Lee: No objections.

Marco Ruiz: Go ahead from infra.

Omar Patel: All set.

Zoom Bot: Meeting scheduled by Alex Kim: "International Office Hours". Cloud recording enabled. Transcript enabled.

Zoom Bot: Recording processed and exported to s3://redwood-assets/webinars/2026-11-03-intl-officehours/full_recording.mp4 with transcript at full_transcript.vtt.
